enabled.name: Enable form badge
enabled.hint: Show an icon of the active shapeshifting form underneath werewolf tokens.

hideSystemIcon.name: Hide built-in status icon
hideSystemIcon.hint: Hide the status-effect icon that the World of Darkness system draws on the token, so it does not duplicate the badge.

showLabel.name: Show form name
showLabel.hint: Display the localized form name next to the icon (e.g. Crinos).

hideHomid.name: Hide in breed form
hideHomid.hint: Do not show the badge while the actor is in its human (Homid) form.

syncUnlinkedTokens.name: Sync form to unlinked tokens
syncUnlinkedTokens.hint: Keeps the base actor and its unlinked tokens in sync: a form changed on the base actor (Actors sidebar sheet) is applied to the tokens, and a form changed on a token is mirrored back to the base actor.

showOnlyObservable.name: Only show on accessible actors
showOnlyObservable.hint: Show the badge only on tokens whose actor this user has at least Limited permission for. Turn off to show the form on every visible token (players included).

formBarEnabled.name: Show form bar
formBarEnabled.hint: Show a small movable panel with buttons to switch the shapeshifting form. Toggle it with the G key.

formBarShowLabels.name: Show form names on the bar
formBarShowLabels.hint: Display the localized form name under each button icon.

badgeSize.name: Badge size
badgeSize.hint: Badge icon size as a fraction of the token width.

opacity.name: Background opacity
opacity.hint: Opacity of the badge background plate.

position.name: Badge position
position.hint: Where the badge is placed relative to the token.

notifications.gmOnly: Only the GM can change the actor link of tokens.
notifications.noPermission: You do not have permission to change this actor's form.
notifications.switchFailed: Failed to switch the form. See the console for details.

toggleFormBar.name: Toggle the shapeshifting form bar
toggleFormBar.hint: Shows or hides the quick form-switching panel.
